bullets.title: MU: IR call bullish – tighter supply/demand through 2028, $33B buyback, HBM leading DRAM growth
bullets.body: UBS sales notes from MU IR call are unambiguously positive: supply/demand tightens materially in 2027-28, 75%+ of supply already committed for 2027 with discussions shifting to 2028 allocations. Over 35% of anticipated revenue through 2030 locked in long-term SCAs; DRAM capex rising to mid-$50bn in F27 vs $8bn in F24. New $33bn share repurchase authorization (3x prior) effective 12/9/26; data center business alone was $10bn in F4Q26. Despite this, MU trades -2.4% premarket amid broad semi weakness.

bullets.title: NVDA: ~80% AI infra revenue share; MS raises AI capex estimate to $1.6T in 2027; Jensen defends CRWV
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley raised AI capex estimates ~14% to $1.6T in 2027 (+60% y/y), rising to $1.8T in 2028, with NVDA controlling ~80% of AI infra revenue share. NVDA CEO Jensen Huang publicly defended CoreWeave, lifting CRWV +6% on close. NVDA is McCullough's neutral and MS's preferred semi name despite AI bubble concerns; GTC Berlin conference Oct 20-22 is a near-term catalyst.

bullets.title: CRWV/NBIS: AI neocloud credit stress – 60% default odds priced, founders cashed $3.3B, $640M annual debt cost
bullets.body: CoreWeave CDS spread hit a record with 60% default odds priced in; founders have cashed out $3.3B in shares. Annual debt servicing costs approach $640M on yields near 15%. CRWV traded 5x avg volume with a violent high-volume reversal suggesting capitulation; stock down ~5% pre-market before bouncing +6% on NVDA CEO defense. Hedgeye explicitly recommends shorts in CRWV and IREN as 'most levered imploding components.'

bullets.title: AAPL: iPhone Duo preorders launch, delivery slipping to Jan 25; CEO flags memory 'crisis'
bullets.body: Apple iPhone Duo preorders went live at 8am ET, with delivery timelines already extending to late January 2027 due to manufacturing constraints, signaling strong demand. AAPL +2-2.5% premarket. New CEO called the memory shortage a 'crisis' and said 'all options should be on the table' for China chips. Q3 smartphone shipments beat at 57.3M units (+22% market share to 22.4%). META's Muse partnering with AAPL for Mac deployment.

bullets.title: SMCI: Analyst Day disappoints (-17%); upgraded to Outperform at Northland; FY27/28 revenue guided >2x each year
bullets.body: SMCI fell 17% at Analyst Day despite guiding FY27 and FY28 revenue growth >2x each year, with data center revenue rising to ~2/3 of sales by FY30. Q3'27 EPS guidance raised to $1.14 ±$0.02 from $1.05 ±$0.03; gross margin guided 59.0%. Northland Capital upgraded to Outperform with $186 PT. CFO transition flagged as an overhang; company needs to stabilize margins and cash flow.

bullets.title: FOXA: BofA upgrades to Buy, PT $85 (from Underperform, $31 implied raise) on Roku deal approval
bullets.body: Bank of America upgraded Fox Corp to Buy from Underperform and raised the price target to $85 (a $54 increase) following Roku shareholders' approval of Fox's acquisition. FOXA is trading +3.5% premarket.

bullets.title: NFLX: -3.3% premarket on CCO Bajaria replaced by ex-DIS/FOXA Peter Rice; earnings Tuesday Oct 20
bullets.body: Netflix replaced Chief Content Officer Bela Bajaria with Peter Rice (ex-Disney/Fox) effective Oct 26, triggering a -3.3% pre-market move. Hedgeye's 4Q26 comms preview notes global Top-10 viewing hours fell 11% in Q3 and TV share down 1 point YoY in July. Netflix reports earnings post-market Tuesday Oct 20.

bullets.title: META: JPM top pick into 3Q earnings; Muse #1 model but 42% weekly user decline flagged; $194B capex in Street models
bullets.body: JPMorgan names META a top pick for 3Q earnings alongside AMZN, SPOT, and GOOGL. META Muse remains the #1 open-weight model and is partnering with Apple for Mac deployment. However, Hedgeye flags a 42% weekly user decline within 3 weeks of Muse launch and notes Street models only ~$194B in 2027 capex with no estimate above $250B, creating a free cash flow funding risk. META earnings pre-market Wednesday Oct 21.

bullets.title: TSLA: +3% premarket on Roadster flying-car reveal; MS analyst turns more constructive
bullets.body: Tesla unveiled a new Roadster at an event featuring SpaceX thrusters, 230+ mph speed, and tie-ins to SPCX, driving a +3% premarket move. Morgan Stanley's Andrew Percoco turns 'more constructive' on Tesla, citing peak negativity passing and Cybercab fleet now at 300+ vehicles in Austin within 30 days. Robotaxi density is flagged as the key 2026 catalyst.

bullets.title: GOOGL: JPM top pick for 3Q; search CTR falling as AI Overviews scale; Argon model near self-improvement
bullets.body: JPMorgan names GOOGL a top pick into 3Q earnings. However, Hedgeye flags GOOGL search click-through fell across all segments in Q3 as AI Overviews scale, and Cloud needs 92% revenue growth consensus for Q4. GOOGL Argon AI model described as approaching a 'self-improvement critical moment.' McCullough is bullish GOOGL on both trade and trend signals.

bullets.title: SMTC: Oppenheimer raises PT to $225; 38% revenue CAGR to $3.2B by 2029, DC growing 75% CAGR
bullets.body: Oppenheimer is bullish on Semtech: management raised CY29 topline/EPS outlook to $3.2B/$12.70 at analyst day, implying a 38% revenue CAGR led by data center AI at 75% CAGR to $2.1B. DC revenue expected to more than double this year and next (~$500M and ~$1B). Google (lead CSP) on track for $100M run rate in 4Q from zero. LoRa growing 60% to $250M/year. Stock trades at 14x CY28E EPS vs AI peer group at 20x.

bullets.title: CSCO: AI networking strategy materializing at OCP; P200 at Microsoft/Alibaba, new G302 announced
bullets.body: Cisco's AI networking strategy is gaining traction per OCP conference takeaways: P200 systems deployed at Microsoft and Alibaba, G300 shipping, new G302 announced, and Silicon One gaining adoption at Meta. MS's OCP note also highlights that NVDA and Cisco announced a USFP pluggable supporting 6.4T bandwidth (roadmap to 12.8T), with pluggables market seen as more durable than expected.

bullets.title: CRDO/LITE/MTSI: OCP semis takeaways – 80M 1.6T units in C27, LITE/MTSI most levered, CRDO underappreciated
bullets.body: Global semis management feedback from OCP shows 80M 1.6T transceiver units expected in C27, with Lumentum and MACOM Technology most levered to the ramp. Credo's ALC, Optical Backplane, and OmniConnect portfolio are flagged as underappreciated, with micro VCSEL 1.6T ALC shipping in C27 and OmniConnect now having multiple customers beyond Positron AI. ALAB's Aries 7 marks its first entry into optical drivers/TIAs.

bullets.title: SHOP: Pricing increases 13-20% on new annual plans; UBS sees immaterial 2027 impact but signals pricing power
bullets.body: Shopify increased Grow/Advanced tier pricing ~13-20% in the US for new annual plans only, with Basic also raised ex-US. Existing customer pricing unchanged. UBS (Neutral) estimates the impact is immaterial to 2027 guidance but notes the move aligns with recent CFO commentary on pricing frequency and signals underlying pricing power.

bullets.title: DKNG: NY OSB GGR -21% YoY for week; 4QTD +4% with stable 32% share vs FanDuel -39%
bullets.body: NY online sports betting data (week ending 10/11): DraftKings weekly GGR -21% YoY but 4QTD GGR +4% YoY, maintaining 32% GGR share vs 31% prior year. FanDuel had a much worse week at -39% GGR YoY on 610bps hold rate decline, with share dropping to 42% from 45%. Fanatics is the clear share gainer at +41% weekly GGR and +62% 4QTD, now at 11% share vs 7% prior year.

bullets.title: ACN: UBS upgrades to Buy, $278 PT; Emerging Alliances revenue doubled, NVDA/OpenAI/Palantir partnerships
bullets.body: UBS upgraded Accenture to Buy with a $278 PT, citing a Federal business recovery (~7% of 2026 revenue), Emerging Alliances bookings tripling YoY, and partnerships with NVIDIA, OpenAI, and Palantir. FQ4 revenue accelerated to +7% local currency; 2027-29 guidance calls for mid-to-high single digit growth by 2029, above Street. Stock rallied ~25% post-10/1 earnings.

bullets.title: VRT/GEV/BE: Schneider Electric reports triple-digit DC demand growth; positive read-through muted by soft tape
bullets.body: Schneider Electric (SU FP) reported triple-digit data center demand growth, described as a positive read-through for Vertiv, GE Vernova, and Bloom Energy. However, all three stocks were down pre-market, with the market 'unimpressed' by the comp data. FPS (Fluence/Power segment proxy) has 90% FY27 revenue guidance coverage from current backlog with F1Q27 actuals and F2Q27 guidance expected above Street.

bullets.title: AMD: Bearish on trade and trend (McCullough); Helion platform at OpenAI/Meta/MSFT/Oracle per OCP
bullets.body: Hedgeye's McCullough maintains AMD bearish on both trade and trend signals alongside INTC. Contrasting bullishly, OCP semis takeaways show AMD Helion infrastructure for agentic AI announced as open rack-scale blueprint launching at OpenAI, Meta, Microsoft, and Oracle, with Vera expected 'highly competitive' in agentic workloads. AMD EPYC Verano is the first EPYC CPU with LPDDR interface, launching in 2027.

bullets.title: BKNG/ABNB/EXPE: Agentic AI in lodging could deflate OTA commissions; MS hosting webcast; AirDNA call on 3Q data
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley hosted a webcast on agentic AI's impact on lodging distribution, arguing that distribution deflation (lower OTA commissions) could drive lodging estimate inflation. Muse partnerships with Expedia and Instacart are highlighted as strategically important. BofA separately hosted an AirDNA expert call on 3Q alternative accommodation data, where nights and ADR growth reportedly improved month-over-month in September.

bullets.title: META/GOOGL/AMZN agentic eCommerce: Truist sees $160B+ market by 2029; ETSY, W, DASH also positioned
bullets.body: Truist published a deep dive on agentic eCommerce, projecting the market grows from <1% of US eCom spend to ~10% by 2029 ($160B+ at 125% CAGR). Meta's Muse is flagged as 'first end-to-end personal AI agent for the open internet.' Google building backend with Gemini optionality; Amazon leveraging 1P data and Alexa. DoorDash, Etsy, and Wayfair adopt an open-access model vs. Amazon's walled garden. Holiday 2026 is the first season with agentic AI transactions.
